#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

bool isAlpha(char a) {
    return (a >= 'A' && a <= 'Z') || (a >= 'a' && a <= 'z');
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    int state = 0;
    int max_val = -1;
    int cur = 0;
    int cur2 = 0;
    int number = 0;
    int i = 0;

    while (i < n) {
        char c = s[i];
        switch (state) {
            case 0:
                if (isAlpha(c)) cur++;
                if (cur > 0 && (c == '_' || c == '(')) {
                    max_val = max(max_val, cur);
                    cur = 0;
                }
                break;
            case 1:
                if (isAlpha(c)) cur2++;
                if (c == '_' || c == ')') {
                    if (cur2 > 0) {
                        number++;
                        cur2 = 0;
                    }
                    if (c == ')') state = 0;
                }
                break;
        }
        if (c == '(') state = 1;
        i++;
    }

    if (cur > 0) {
        max_val = max(max_val, cur);
    }

    cout << (max_val == -1 ? 0 : max_val) << " ";
    cout << number << endl;

    return 0;
}
